name: get_ta_summary
description: Get TradingView-style technical analysis summary for one or more symbols across multiple timeframes. Returns buy/sell/neutral labels and recommendation scores based on oscillators and moving averages.

include_components.description: Include oscillator and moving average scores breakdown (default: true)

symbols.description: Array of ticker symbols (e.g., ['NASDAQ:AAPL', 'NASDAQ:NVDA']). Maximum 50 symbols.
